LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantCore.label: frost giant origin
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantCore.description: The ice field bloodline of frost giants, inherited with the race. Adults are 2.0 times the size of an ordinary person (drawn 1.4×, children grow with age); the bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (giant-body rules: adult health ×150%, melee ×130%); long strides, but not fast. Frost giants don't fear cold: min comfortable temperature -80°C, no hypothermia or frostbite, and the ice devil's chill and the winter wolf bite's frost slow don't work on them. They don't care about nudity and can wear ordinary clothes.
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantCore.customEffectDescriptio: Giant lineage: frost giant (rank 4 of the ordning, below fire giants).
Body size grows with age, reaching ×2.0 as an adult (drawn ×1.4).
Giant-body rules: adult total health ×150%, melee damage ×130% (adjustable in mod settings; health is still ×150% when off).
Giant stomach: max food rises with body size, ×200% as an adult.
Never gets hypothermia or frostbite; unaffected by "chilled to the bone" and "frost slowed".
No negative mood from nudity; can wear ordinary clothes; each piece of giant-only apparel gives mood +2 (up to +6).
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantCore.modExtensions.0.label: frost giant
LanguageData.LP_FrostSnowWalker.label: snow walker
LanguageData.LP_FrostSnowWalker.description: Strides even through knee-deep snow: snow doesn't slow movement. Doesn't feel cold working in ice and snow (no "cold" mood).
LanguageData.LP_FrostSnowWalker.customEffectDescripti: No slowdown from snow (doesn't affect pathfinding detour decisions).
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantFrailty.label: fire-shy
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiantFrailty.description: A frost giant's body can't take fire and can't stand warm weather: fire damage taken ×150%, max comfortable temperature -22°C.
LanguageData.LP_FrostWolfLord.label: master of winter wolves
LanguageData.LP_FrostWolfLord.description: Winter wolves know a frost giant's scent. Taming winter wolves ×300% success, arctic wolves and timber wolves ×150% (up to 100%); winter wolves don't turn on you when taming fails or they're hurt by accident. Winter wolves whose master is this frost giant get melee damage ×115% and move speed ×110%.
LanguageData.LP_FrostLootHeart.label: heart of plunder
LanguageData.LP_FrostLootHeart.description: Frost giants are born raiders. After beating off a raid, mood +5 for 3 days (spoils of war); for each 1000 silver of market value of weapons and armor on the map not made by the colony (scattered or stored, not worn), mood +1, up to +4.
LanguageData.LP_SkinFrost.label: permafrost skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinFrost.description: A frost giant's pale blue-grey skin, like frozen earth.
LanguageData.LP_HairFrost.label: frost-white hair
LanguageData.LP_HairFrost.description: White hair tinged with blue, as if covered in frost.
LanguageData.LP_FrostBraids.label: frosted braids
LanguageData.LP_FrostBraids.description: Frost giants braid their hair into two thick braids with ice beads and bone rings at the tips.
